-- https://golang.org/src/sort/search.go?s=2246:2286#L49
local function find_min_true(n, f)
    local function range_ok(x)
        return x >= 1 and x <= n
    end
    local function loop(i, j)
        -- Define f(0) == false, f(n+1) == true
        -- Invariant: f(i-1) == false and f(j) == true
        if i == j then
            assert(i >= 1 and i <= n + 1) -- i == n + 1 is valid
            -- i == j, f(i-1) == false, f(i) == true
            -- i is the minimum number that f(i) == true
            return i
        end
        local h = (i + j) // 2
        assert(h >= 1 and h <= n)
        if f(h) then
            -- f(h) == true
            -- j = h ==> f(j) == true
            return loop(i, h)
        else
            -- f(h) == false
            -- i = h + 1 ==> f(i-1) == false
            return loop(h + 1, j)
        end
    end
    -- f(i-1) == f(0) == false
    -- f(j) == f(n+1) == true
    return loop(1, n + 1)
end

parseChar2 :: Parser (Char, Char)

    (,) <$> StateT (C.uncons . C.dropWhile isSpace)

solve0 :: Int -> String-> U.Vector (Char, Char) -> Int
solve0 n cs (U.reverse -> qs) = max 0 $ n - go 0 cs revL - go 0 (reverse cs) revR
  where
    revL = U.toList . U.map fst $ U.filter ((=='L').snd) qs
    revR = U.toList . U.map fst $ U.filter ((=='R').snd) qs

    go !acc (x:xs) (y:ys)
        | x == y = go (acc + 1) xs ys
        | otherwise = go acc (x:xs) ys
    go acc _ _ = acc

solve :: Int -> String -> U.Vector (Char, Char) -> Int
solve n cs qs = go 0 (n + 1) . U.toList $ U.reverse qs
  where
    !bs = C.pack $ '#':cs ++ "#"
    -- go l r _ | traceShow (l, r) False = undefined
    go l r ((c,'L'):qs) = go l' r' qs
      where
        l' | l == n + 1 = n + 1
           | C.index bs (l + 1) == c = l + 1
           | otherwise = l
        r' | r == n + 1 = n + 1
           | C.index bs r == c = r + 1
           | otherwise = r
    go l r ((c,'R'):qs) = go l' r' qs
      where
        l' | l == 0 = 0
           | C.index bs l == c = l - 1
           | otherwise = l

        r' | r == 0 = 0
           | c == C.index bs (r - 1) = r - 1
           | otherwise = r
    go l r [] = r - l - 1

solve n s tds = rbound - lbound - 1
  where
    rbound = if vanishRight n 
             then lowerBound vanishRight (1, n) 
             else n + 1
    lbound = if vanishLeft 1

             else 0

          | otherwise = if sarr ! i == t

                            else go (i-1) $ tail tds
                        else go i $ tail tds
            where (t, d) = head tds

    vanishLeft i = go i tds
      where
        go :: Int -> [(Char, Char)] -> Bool
        go i tds
          | i < 1 = True
          | i > n = False
          | null tds = False
          | otherwise = if sarr ! i == t
                        then if d == 'R'
                            then go (i+1) $ tail tds
                            else go (i-1) $ tail tds
                        else go i $ tail tds
            where (t, d) = head tds
          
lowerBound :: (Int -> Bool) -> (Int, Int) -> Int
lowerBound predicate bounds = go bounds
  where
    go (l, h) | l + 1 == h = h
              | predicate m = go (l, m)
              | otherwise = go (m, h)
      where m = (l + h) `div` 2
    
upperBound :: (Int -> Bool) -> (Int, Int) -> Int
upperBound predicate bounds = go bounds
  where
    go (l, h) | l + 1 == h = l
              | predicate m = go (m, h)
              | otherwise = go (l, m)
      where m = (l + h) `div` 2

data Spell = L Char | R Char deriving Show

toSpell :: String -> String -> Spell
toSpell [c] "L" = L c
toSpell [c] "R" = R c
toSpell _   _   = error "irregular"

type Index = Map Char [Int]
type Field = IntMap Int

solve :: Int -> String -> [Spell] -> Int
solve n s spells = sum $ foldl' (flip (update' n (index s))) (initial n) spells

index :: String -> Map Char [Int]
index s = M.fromListWith (++) $ zip s $ map pure [1..]

initial :: Int -> Field
initial n = IM.fromDistinctAscList $ zip [1..n] $ repeat 1

update' :: Int -> Index -> Spell -> Field -> Field
update' n index' (L c) field =
  let
    targetIndeces = M.findWithDefault [] c index'
    (target, rest) = IM.partitionWithKey (\k _ -> k `elem` targetIndeces) field
  in
    IM.unionWith (+) (cut n $ IM.mapKeysMonotonic pred target) rest
update' n index' (R c) field =
  let
    targetIndeces = M.findWithDefault [] c index'
    (target, rest) = IM.partitionWithKey (\k _ -> k `elem` targetIndeces) field
  in
    IM.unionWith (+) (cut n $ IM.mapKeysMonotonic succ target) rest

cut :: Int -> Field -> Field
cut n = IM.delete 0 . IM.delete (n + 1)

  where

            | C.index bs r == c = r + 1
            | otherwise = r

      where
        !l' | l == 0 = 0
            | C.index bs l == c = l - 1
            | otherwise = l
        !r' | r == 0 = 0
            | c == C.index bs (r - 1) = r - 1
            | otherwise = r

data Spell = Spell Char Direction

data Direction = L | R

toSpell :: String -> String -> Spell
toSpell [c] "L" = Spell c L
toSpell [c] "R" = Spell c R
toSpell _   _   = error "irregular"

solve :: Int -> String -> [Spell] -> Int
solve n s spells =
  let
    l = bisect1 (\i -> extract (destination s spells i) == LeftEdge) 0 n
    r = bisect2 (\i -> extract (destination s spells i) == RightEdge) 0 n
  in
    r - l

bisect1 :: (Int -> Bool) -> Int -> Int -> Int
bisect1 p lowerB upperB -- section: [lowerB, upperB)
  | upperB - lowerB == 1 = lowerB
  | p middle             = bisect1 p middle upperB
  | otherwise            = bisect1 p lowerB middle
  where
    middle = (lowerB + upperB) `div` 2

bisect2 :: (Int -> Bool) -> Int -> Int -> Int
bisect2 p lowerB upperB -- section: [lowerB, upperB)
  | upperB - lowerB == 1 = lowerB
  | p middle             = bisect2 p lowerB middle
  | otherwise            = bisect2 p middle upperB
  where
    middle = (lowerB + upperB) `div` 2

data WithEdge a = LeftEdge | Inner a | RightEdge
  deriving (Eq)

destination :: String -> [Spell] -> Int -> Zipper (WithEdge Char)
destination s spells i = foldl' update zipper spells
  where
    zipper = nTimes (i + 1) right $ fromList $ [LeftEdge] ++ map Inner s ++ [RightEdge]

    update z (Spell c d) =
      case (extract z == Inner c, d) of
        (False, _) -> z
        (True, L)  -> left z
        (True, R)  -> right z

fromList :: [a] -> Zipper a
fromList []       = error "non empty"
fromList (x : xs) = Zipper [] x xs

nTimes :: Int -> (a -> a) -> a -> a
nTimes n f x = iterate f x !! n

data Zipper a = Zipper [a] a [a]

extract :: Zipper a -> a
extract (Zipper _ x _) = x

left :: Zipper a -> Zipper a
left z@(Zipper [] _ _)      = z
left (Zipper (l : ls) x rs) = Zipper ls l (x : rs)

right :: Zipper a -> Zipper a
right z@(Zipper _ _ [])      = z
right (Zipper ls x (r : rs)) = Zipper (x : ls) r rs

solve :: Int -> Int -> B.ByteString -> VU.Vector (Char, Char) -> Int
solve !n !q !s !tds =
  binsearchR (-1) (B.length s) - binsearchL (-1) (B.length s) + 1
 where
  remainLeft !n = simulate n >= 0
  remainRight !n = simulate n < B.length s

  simulate !n = VU.foldr'
    (\(!t, !d) !i -> if i < 0 || i >= B.length s
      then i
      else if t == B.index s i then (if d == 'L' then i - 1 else i + 1) else i
    )
    n
    (VU.reverse tds)

  -- search in (x,y]
  binsearchL !x !y
    | y - x == 1
    = y
    | otherwise
    = let !z = (x + y) `div` 2
      in  if remainLeft z then binsearchL x z else binsearchL z y

  -- search in [x,y)
  binsearchR !x !y
    | y - x == 1
    = x
    | otherwise
    = let !z = (x + y) `div` 2
      in  if remainRight z then binsearchR z y else binsearchR x z

{- 
-- Binary search over {arr}, ranging from {l} to {r},
-- with the searching strategy {f}, where the direction
-- {pref} is preferred when the border lands between two elements.
-}
binSearch :: Array Int a -> (Int, Int) -> (Array Int a -> Int -> Dir) -> Dir -> Int
binSearch arr (l,r) f pref
    | l   == r  = r
    | l+1 == r  = case (f arr l, f arr r) of
        (R,R) -> r
        (R,L) -> case pref of L->l; R->r
        (L,L) -> l
        (L,R) -> error "Non-consistent searching strategy"
    | otherwise = let curPos = (l+r) `div` 2 in
        case f arr curPos of
            L -> binSearch arr (l, curPos) f pref
            R -> binSearch arr (curPos, r) f pref

---- # searching strategies

findLeftmostNonZero :: [(Char,Dir)] -> Int -> Array Int Char -> Int -> Dir
findLeftmostNonZero spells lim field curPos =
        if performSpell spells field lim curPos == 0
            then R else L

findRightmostNonLim :: [(Char,Dir)] -> Int -> Array Int Char -> Int -> Dir
findRightmostNonLim spells lim field curPos =
        if performSpell spells field lim curPos == lim+1
            then L else R

---- # wizardry

performSpell :: [(Char,Dir)] -> Array Int Char -> Int -> Int -> Int
performSpell spells field lim iniPos =
    foldl (spellStep field lim) iniPos spells    

spellStep :: Array Int Char -> Int -> Int -> (Char,Dir) -> Int
spellStep field lim cur_pos (target,dir)
    | cur_pos<1 || lim<cur_pos = cur_pos
    | field!cur_pos == target = case dir of
            L -> cur_pos - 1
            R -> cur_pos + 1
    | otherwise  = cur_pos

query :: BS.ByteString -> VU.Vector (Char,Bool) -> Int
query s qs = g - e
  where
    len = BS.length s
    (e,g) = ltgt (-1) len
    ltgt !lt !gt
      | gt - lt <= 1 = (gt,gt)
      | otherwise = case goDown s qs mid of
                      GT -> ltgt lt mid
                      LT -> ltgt mid gt
                      EQ -> (lteq lt mid, eqgt mid gt)
      where mid = lt + (gt - lt) `shiftR` 1
    lteq !lt !eq
      | eq - lt <= 1 = eq
      | otherwise = case goDown s qs mid of
                      LT -> lteq mid eq
                      EQ -> lteq lt mid
      where mid = lt + (eq - lt) `shiftR` 1
    eqgt !eq !gt
      | gt - eq <= 1 = gt
      | otherwise = case goDown s qs mid of
                      EQ -> eqgt mid gt
                      GT -> eqgt eq mid
      where mid = eq + (gt - eq) `shiftR` 1


goDown :: BS.ByteString -> VU.Vector (Char,Bool) -> Int -> Ordering
goDown s = VU.foldr
  (\(!called,!dir) cont !i ->
     if | i >= BS.length s -> GT
        | i < 0 -> LT
        | called /= BS.index s i -> cont i
        | dir -> cont $! i+1
        | otherwise -> cont $! i-1)
  (\ !i -> if | i >= BS.length s -> GT
              | i < 0 -> LT
              | otherwise -> EQ)

data Result = LeftVanished | Alive | RightVanished

readInts :: IO [Int]

solve :: Int -> Vector Char -> [[Char]] -> Int
solve n s tds = aliveEnd - aliveBegin + 1
  where
    aliveBegin = go_b 0 n
    aliveEnd   = go_e 0 n

    go_b begin end
      | end - begin <= 1 = end
      | otherwise        = let center = (end + begin) `div` 2 in
        case result n s tds center of
          LeftVanished -> go_b center end
          _            -> go_b begin center

    go_e begin end
      | end - begin <= 1 = end
      | otherwise        = let center = (end + begin) `div` 2 in
        case result n s tds center of
          RightVanished -> go_b begin center
          _             -> go_b center end

result :: Int -> Vector Char -> [[Char]] -> Int -> Result
result _ _ []          _       = Alive
result n s ([t,d]:tds) i
  | (s ! i) /= t             = result n s tds i
  | d == 'L' && i == 0       = LeftVanished
  | d == 'L' && i >  0       = result n s tds (i - 1)
  | d == 'R' && i == (n - 1) = RightVanished
  | d == 'R' && i <  (n - 1) = result n s tds (i + 1)

buildMap :: String -> Int -> Map.Map Char [Int] -> Map.Map Char [Int]
buildMap [] _ mp = mp
buildMap (x:xs) n mp = insertMap x n (buildMap xs (n+1) mp)

insertMap :: Char -> Int -> Map.Map Char [Int] -> Map.Map Char [Int]
insertMap c n mp =
    case Map.lookup c mp of
        Just ls -> Map.insert c (n:ls) mp
        _       -> Map.insert c [n] mp

spell :: Map.Map Char [Int] -> [Int] -> Int -> Int -> IO [Int]
spell mp ls _ 0 = return ls
spell mp ls n q = do
    [t:_,d:_] <- words <$> getLine :: IO [String]
    case Map.lookup t mp of
        Just letterLs -> do
            let diff = subLs letterLs ls
            let subls = zipWith subtract diff ls
            let ls' = case d of
                    'L' -> zipWith (+) subls (tail diff ++ [0])
                    'R' -> zipWith (+) subls (0:diff)
            spell mp ls' n (q-1)
        Nothing -> spell mp ls n (q-1)

-- Assuming 1st arg is ordered
subLs :: [Int] -> [Int] -> [Int]
subLs = zoLsAux 1
    where
        zoLsAux _ [] ns = replicate (length ns) 0
        zoLsAux _ _ [] = []

solve :: Int -> Int -> B.ByteString -> VU.Vector (Char, Char) -> Int
solve !n !q !s !tds =
  binsearchR 0 (B.length s) - binsearchL (-1) (B.length s - 1) + 1
 where
  remainLeft !n = simulate n >= 0
  remainRight !n = simulate n < B.length s

  simulate !n = VU.foldr'
    (\(!t, !d) !i -> if i < 0 || i >= B.length s
      then i
      else
        let ch = B.index s i
        in  if t == ch then (if d == 'L' then i - 1 else i + 1) else i
    )
    n
    (VU.reverse tds)

  -- search in (x,y]
  binsearchL !x !y
    | y - x == 1
    = y
    | otherwise
    = let !z = (x + y) `div` 2
      in  if remainLeft z then binsearchL x z else binsearchL z y

  -- search in [x,y)
  binsearchR !x !y
    | y - x == 1
    = x
    | otherwise
    = let !z = (x + y) `div` 2
      in  if remainRight z then binsearchR z y else binsearchR x z

-- ## Algos ###

-- Binary search over {arr}, ranging from {l} to {r},
-- with the targeting logic {f}
binSearch :: Array Int a -> (Int, Int) -> (Array Int a -> Int -> Dir) -> Int
binSearch arr (l,r) f
    | l+1 >= r  = case (f arr l, f arr r) of
        (R,R) -> r+1
        (R,L) -> r
        (L,L) -> l
        (L,R) -> error "Erroneous targeting logic"
    | otherwise = let curPos = (l+r) `div` 2 in
        case f arr curPos of
            L -> binSearch arr (l, curPos) f
            R -> binSearch arr (curPos, r) f

---- # targeting logic

findLeftmostNonZero :: [(Char,Dir)] -> Int -> Array Int Char -> Int -> Dir
findLeftmostNonZero spells lim field curPos =
        if performSpell spells field lim curPos == 0
            then R else L

findRightmostNonLim :: [(Char,Dir)] -> Int -> Array Int Char -> Int -> Dir
findRightmostNonLim spells lim field curPos =
        if performSpell spells field lim curPos == lim+1
            then L else R

---- # wizardry

performSpell :: [(Char,Dir)] -> Array Int Char -> Int -> Int -> Int
performSpell spells field lim iniPos =
    foldl (spellStep field lim) iniPos spells    

spellStep :: Array Int Char -> Int -> Int -> (Char,Dir) -> Int
spellStep field lim cur_pos (target,dir)
    | cur_pos<1 || lim<cur_pos = cur_pos
    | field!cur_pos == target = case dir of
            L -> cur_pos - 1
            R -> cur_pos + 1
    | otherwise  = cur_pos

solver_l::Array Int Char ->Int->[(Char,String)]->Int
solver_l ar i [] = 0
solver_l ar i ((c,d):xs) = if i> snd (bounds ar)
                           then 0
                           else if not (ar!i==c && d == "L")
                                then solver_l ar i xs
                                else if (ar!i==c && d == "R")
                                     then  solver_l ar (max (fst (bounds ar)) (i-1)) xs
                                     else 1 + (solver_l ar (i+1) xs)

solver_r::Array Int Char ->Int->[(Char,String)]->Int
solver_r ar j [] = 0
solver_r ar j ((c,d):xs) = if j< fst (bounds ar)
                           then 0
                           else if not (ar!j==c && d == "R")
                                then solver_r ar j xs
                                else if (ar!j==c && d == "L")
                                     then solver_r ar (min (snd (bounds ar)) (j+1)) xs
                                     else 1 + (solver_r ar (j-1) xs)

solver::Array Int Char -> Int -> Int ->[(Char,String)]->Int
solver ar i j [] = 0
solver ar i j ((c,d):xs) = if j<i
                           then 0
                           else if not ((ar!i==c && d == "L")||(ar!j==c && d == "R"))
                                then if not ((ar!i==c && d == "R")||(ar!j==c && d == "L"))
                                     then  (solver ar i j xs)
                                     else if d == "R"
                                          then solver ar (max (fst (bounds ar)) (i-1)) j xs
                                          else solver ar i (min (snd (bounds ar)) (j+1)) xs
                                else if d == "L"
                                     then 1 + (solver ar (i+1) j xs)
                                     else 1 + (solver ar i (j-1) xs)

parseChar2 :: Parser (Char, Char)
parseChar2 = runStateT $
    (,) <$> StateT (C.uncons . C.dropWhile isSpace)
        <*> StateT (C.uncons . C.dropWhile isSpace)

solve :: Int -> C.ByteString -> U.Vector (Char, Char) -> Int
solve n cs qs = pred . uncurry (flip (-)) $ U.foldr' step (0, n + 1) qs
  where
    !bs = '#' `C.cons` C.snoc cs '#'
    step (c,'L') (l, r) = (l', r')
      where
        !l' | l == n + 1 = n + 1
            | C.index bs (l + 1) == c = l + 1
            | otherwise = l
        !r' | r == n + 1 = n + 1
            | C.index bs r == c = r + 1
            | otherwise = r
    step (c,'R') (l, r) = (l', r')
      where
        !l' | l == 0 = 0
            | C.index bs l == c = l - 1
            | otherwise = l
        !r' | r == 0 = 0
            | c == C.index bs (r - 1) = r - 1
            | otherwise = r

 |(spell!!0!!1)=="R" = f (drop 1 spell) s (zipWith (\sp gp -> if sp==(spell!!0!!0) then gp+1 else gp) s g)
 |otherwise = f (drop 1 spell) s (zipWith (\sp gp -> if sp==(spell!!0!!0) then gp-1 else gp) s g)

import Data.Array

solver_l::Array Int Char ->Int->[(Char,String)]->Int
solver_l ar i [] = 0
solver_l ar i ((c,d):xs) = if i> snd (bounds ar)
                           then 0
                           else if not (ar!i==c && d == "L")
                                then solver_l ar i xs
                                else 1 + (solver_l ar (i+1) xs)

solver_r::Array Int Char ->Int->[(Char,String)]->Int
solver_r ar j [] = 0
solver_r ar j ((c,d):xs) = if j< fst (bounds ar)
                           then 0
                           else if not (ar!j==c && d == "R")
                                then solver_r ar j xs
                                else 1 + (solver_r ar (j-1) xs)

(defmacro buffered-read-line (&optional (buffer-size 30) (in '*standard-input*) (terminate-char #\Space))
  "Note that the returned string will be reused."
  (let ((buffer (gensym))
        (character (gensym))
        (idx (gensym)))
    `(let ((,buffer (load-time-value (make-string ,buffer-size
                                                  :element-type 'base-char))))
       (declare (simple-base-string ,buffer))
       (loop for ,character of-type base-char =
                #-swank (code-char (read-byte ,in nil #.(char-code #\Newline)))
                #+swank (read-char ,in nil #\Newline)
             for ,idx from 0
             until (char= ,character #\Newline)
             do (setf (schar ,buffer ,idx) ,character)
             finally (when (< ,idx ,buffer-size)
                       (setf (schar ,buffer ,idx) ,terminate-char))
                     (return (values ,buffer ,idx))))))

(defun main ()

         (seq (make-array n :element-type 'uint7))
         (operations (make-array q :element-type '(cons int32 int32))))
    (declare (uint32 n q))
    (read-line-into s)
    (dotimes (i n)
      (setf (aref seq i) (to-code (aref s i))))
    (dotimes (i q)
      (let* ((line (buffered-read-line 3))
             (code (to-code (char line 0)))
             (direction (if (char= #\L (char line 2)) -1 1)))
        (setf (aref operations i) (cons code direction))))
    (labels ((escape-right-p (pos)
               (declare (int32 pos))
               (dotimes (i q nil)
                 (when (= pos -1)
                   (return nil))
                 (when (= pos n)
                   (return t))
                 (let* ((op (aref operations i))
                        (dir (cdr op))
                        (object (car op)))
                   (declare (int32 object dir))
                   (when (= (aref seq pos) object)
                     (incf pos dir))))
               (if (= pos n) t nil))
             (escape-left-p (pos)
               (declare (int32 pos))
               (dotimes (i q nil)
                 (when (= pos -1)
                   (return t))
                 (when (= pos n)
                   (return nil))
                 (let* ((op (aref operations i))
                        (dir (cdr op))
                        (object (car op)))
                   (declare (int32 object dir))
                   (when (= (aref seq pos) object)
                     (incf pos dir))))
               (if (= pos -1) t nil)))
      (let ((p (if (escape-right-p 0)
                   0
                   (if (not (escape-right-p (- n 1)))
                       n
                       (nlet bisect ((ng 0) (ok n))
                         (declare (int32 ng ok))
                         (if (<= (- ok ng) 1)
                             ok
                             (let ((mid (floor (+ ng ok) 2)))

                       (nlet bisect ((ok 0) (ng (- n 1)))
                         (declare (int32 ng ok))
                         (if (<= (- ng ok) 1)

                             (let ((mid (floor (+ ng ok) 2)))
                               (if (escape-left-p mid)

def bsearch(i, j, &block)
  if i+1 == j
    return i
  else
    mid = (i+j)/2
    if yield mid
      bsearch(mid,j,&block)
    else
      bsearch(i,mid,&block)
    end
  end
end

def gets; ARGF.gets; end

class Solver

  def initialize
  end

  def main
    @n, @q = gets.split.map(&:to_i)
    @s = gets.chomp
    # puts n, q

    @dirs = Array.new(@q)
    @q.times do |i|
      @dirs[i] = gets.split
    end
    # puts dirs

    # 二分探索で
    # ・左に出ていく最も右側のゴーレムの初期位置
    # ・右に出ていく最も左側のゴーレムの初期位置
    # を調べる
    # ゴーレムが他のゴーレムを追い抜くことはありえないので、
    # それらの外側のゴーレムはすべてどちらかのサイドに出ていくことになる。

    # まずは左に抜けていかない最も左側 を調べる
    ary = [*0...@n]  # 0 - (n-1) の配列
    lower = ary.bsearch_index do |i|
      is_ok(i)
    end
    # puts lower

    # 次に右に抜けていく最も左側 を調べる
    upper = ary.bsearch_index(&method(:is_ok_r))
    # puts upper

    ans = @n
    lower = @n if lower.nil?  # 全部左に抜ける
    if 0 < lower
      ans -= lower
    end
    upper = @n if upper.nil?
    if 0 < upper
      ans -= @n - upper
    end
    puts ans
  end

  private
  def is_ok(i)
    cur_i = i
    @dirs.each do |(ch, dir)|
      if @s[cur_i] == ch
        if dir == 'L'
          cur_i -= 1
          # 左に抜けた ＝条件を満たさない
          return false if cur_i < 0
        else
          cur_i += 1
          # 右に抜けた ＝左には抜けていかない＝条件を満たす
          return true if @n <= cur_i
        end
      end
    end
    # 生き残った ＝条件を満たす
    true
  end

  def is_ok_r(i)
    cur_i = i
    @dirs.each do |(ch, dir)|
      if @s[cur_i] == ch
        if dir == 'L'
          cur_i -= 1
          # 左に抜けた ＝条件を満たさない
          return false if cur_i < 0
        else
          cur_i += 1
          # 右に抜けた ＝条件を満たす
          return true if @n <= cur_i
        end
      end
    end
    # 生き残った ＝条件を満たさない
    false
  end
end

def bsearch(i, j, &block)
  if i+1 == j
    return i
  else
    mid = (i+j)/2
    if yield mid
      bsearch(mid,j,&block)
    else
      bsearch(i,mid,&block)
    end
  end
end

def reaches_left(pos)
  return false if pos >= N
  OPS.each do |(c,dir)|
    if S[pos] == c
      pos = (dir == 'L') ? pos-1 : pos + 1
      return true if pos < 0
    end
  end
  false
end
def reaches_right(pos)
  return false if pos < 0
  OPS.each do |(c,dir)|
    if S[pos] == c
      pos = (dir == 'L') ? pos-1 : pos + 1
      return true if pos >= N
    end
  end
  false
end

def get_dead_pos(lef0, rht0, nn0, isLeftS)
    lef = lef0
    rht = rht0
    cen = (rht+lef)/2
    isAlive = true
    while true
          isFinal = false
          golem = 0
          #puts "#{lef} | #{cen} | #{rht}"
          $commands.each_with_index do |cmd, cnt|
            s = cmd[:target]
            direct = cmd[:direct]
            isFinal = (cnt == ($commands.length-1))
            #$golems.map! do |golem|
            golem = $golems[cen]
                p = golem
                #puts $names[p]
                if (p >= 0 && $names[p] == s) then
                    if direct then
                        p = p - 1
                    else
                        p = p + 1
                    end
                end
                #puts p
                golem = p
                $golems[cen] = golem
                if (p < lef0 || p > rht0) then
                    break
                end
            #end
          end
          if not isLeftS then
              if (nn0 <= golem) then # 死んだ
                 isAlive = false
                 if isFinal then # ちょうど死んだ
                   break
                 else
                   # いきてるやつを探す
                   rht = cen
                   cen = (lef+cen)/2
                   break if (rht==cen) # 計算が収束している
                 end
              else
                lef = cen
                cen = (rht+cen)/2
                break if (lef==cen) # 計算が収束している
              end
          else
              #puts golem
              if (0 > golem) then # 死んだ
                 isAlive = false
                 if isFinal then # ちょうど死んだ
                   break
                 else
                   lef = cen
                   cen = (rht+cen)/2
                   break if (lef==cen) # 計算が収束している
                 end
              else
                rht = cen
                cen = (lef+cen)/2
                break if (rht==cen) # 計算が収束している
              end
          end
    end
    #puts "return: #{cen} #{isAlive}"
    return cen,isAlive
end # function

class Solver
  attr_reader :n

  def initialize(n, q, s, spells)
    @n = n
    @q = q
    @s = s
    @spells = spells
    @memo = {}
  end

  def search(dir)
    l = 1
    r = @n + 1
    loop do
      break if r - l == 1
      n = (r + l) / 2
      if shrink_r?(dir, solve(n))
        r = n
      else
        l = n
      end
    end
    l
  end

  def shrink_r?(dir, ans)
    return true if ans == :r_out
    return false if ans == :l_out
    dir == :L
  end

  def solve(n)
    @memo[n] ||=
      begin
        cur = n
        @spells.each do |target, d|
          next if target != @s[cur - 1]
          if d == 'L'
            cur -= 1
          else
            cur += 1
          end
          return :l_out if cur == 0
          return :r_out if cur == @n + 1
        end

        :alive
      end
  end
end

	global $qs;
	global $s;
	global $n;
	$res = false;
	for ($i=0; $i < count($qs); $i++) { 
		$tmp_s = $s[$p];
		$q = $qs[$i];
		if ($q['t'] === $tmp_s) {
			if ($q['d'] === 'L') {
				--$p;
			}else{
				++$p;
			}
		}
		if ($p < 0 || $p > $n-1) {
			if ($p < 0) {
				$res = true;
			}
			break;
		}
	}
	return $res;
}
function toRight($p){
	global $qs;
	global $s;

		$tmp_s = $s[$p];

				$res = true;
			}

	}

let mk_accessor s =
  let buf = Array.make 27 [] in
  for i = 0 to (String.length s) - 1 do
    let idx = (Char.code @@ String.get s i) - (Char.code 'A') in
    buf.(idx) <- (i)::buf.(idx)
  done;
  (fun a -> let idx = (Char.code a) - (Char.code 'A') in buf.(idx))

let cmd_l cells ls =
  let ls = List.rev ls in
  let rec inner = function
  | [] -> ()
  | l::ls when l = 0 -> cells.(l) <- 0; inner ls
  | l::ls -> cells.(l - 1) <- cells.(l - 1) + cells.(l); cells.(l) <- 0; inner ls
  in inner ls

let rec cmd_r cells n = function
    | [] -> ()
    | r::rs when r = (n-1) -> cells.(r) <- 0; cmd_r cells n rs
    | r::rs -> cells.(r + 1) <- cells.(r + 1) + cells.(r); cells.(r) <- 0; cmd_r cells n rs

let count cells n = 
  let ans = ref 0 in for i = 0 to (n-1) do ans := !ans + (cells.(i)) done; !ans

let memoize n f =
  let dp = Hashtbl.create n in
  let rec get x =
    try Hashtbl.find dp x with
    | Not_found ->
        let result = f get x in
        Hashtbl.add dp x result;
        result in
  get

  let next =
    let next = Array.make (q + 1) CharMap.empty in
    for i = q - 1 downto 0 do
      next.(i) <- CharMap.add (fst tds.(i)) i next.(i + 1)
    done;
    fun i c ->
      try CharMap.find c next.(i)
      with Not_found -> q in
  let dp = memoize (n + q) @@ fun dp (i, j) ->
    0 <= j && j < n && (q <= i || 
    if snd tds.(i) = 'L'
    then 0 <= j - 1 && dp (next (i + 1) s.[j - 1], j - 1)
    else j + 1 < n && dp (next (i + 1) s.[j + 1], j + 1)) in
  Printf.printf "%d\n" @@
  Array.fold_left ( + ) 0 @@
  Array.init n @@ fun i ->
    if dp (next 0 s.[i], i) then 1 else 0

  result = newNimNode(nnkStmtList)

  for i, _ in vars:

      for ident in body[i][0]:

      vars[i].add(newEmptyNode())

                    .add(ident("input"))

                 )
    elif body[i][1][0].len == 0: # variable: int | float | string
      vars[i] = newIdentDefs(
        body[i][0],
        newEmptyNode(),
        newNimNode(nnkCall)
          .add(ident("input"))
          .add(body[i][1][0])
          .add(newLit(1))
      )
    elif body[i][1][0][0].len > 0: # variable: tuple[field1, field2, ...: T]
      var tupleIdents = newNimNode(nnkIdentDefs)
      for ident in body[i][1][0][0]:
        tupleIdents.add(ident)
      let tuplety = newNimNode(nnkTupleTy).add(tupleIdents)

      vars[i] = newIdentDefs(
        body[i][0],
        tuplety,
        newNimNode(nnkCall)
          .add(ident("input"))
          .add(body[i][1][0][0][^2])
          .add(newLit(body[i][1][0][0].len - 2))
      )
    elif body[i][1][0][0].len == 0: # seq
      if body[i][1][0].len == 2: # variable: seq[int | float | string | char]
        vars[i] = newIdentDefs(
          body[i][0],
          newEmptyNode(),
          newNimNode(nnkCall)
            .add(ident("input"))
            .add(body[i][1][0][1])
        )

        vars[i] = newIdentDefs(
          body[i][0],
          newEmptyNode(),
          newNimNode(nnkCall)
            .add(ident("input"))
            .add(body[i][1][0][2])
            .add(newLit(1))
            .add(body[i][1][0][1])
        )
      elif body[i][1][0][2].len == 2: # variable: seq[lineCount, seq[int | float | string | char]]
        vars[i] = newIdentDefs(
          body[i][0],
          newEmptyNode(),
          newNimNode(nnkCall)
            .add(ident("input"))
            .add(body[i][1][0][2][1])
            .add(newNimNode(nnkDotExpr)
              .add(body[i][1][0][1])
              .add(ident("Positive"))
            )
        )
      else: # variable: seq[lineCount, tuple[field1, field2, ...: T]]
        var tupleIdents = newNimNode(nnkIdentDefs)
        for ident in body[i][1][0][2][0]:
          tupleIdents.add(ident)
        let tuplety = newNimNode(nnkTupleTy).add(tupleIdents)

        vars[i] = newIdentDefs(
          body[i][0],
          newNimNode(nnkBracketExpr).add(body[i][1][0][0]).add(tuplety),
          newNimNode(nnkCall)
            .add(ident("input"))
            .add(body[i][1][0][2][0][^2])
            .add(newLit(body[i][1][0][2][0].len - 2))
            .add(body[i][1][0][1])
        )
    else:
      discard

  for `var` in vars:
    letSection.add(`var`)

  result.add(letSection)

  while r - l > 1:
    let m = (l + r) div 2
    if f(m): r = m
    else: l = m

  while r - l > 1:

    if f(m): l = m

# [lb, ub)
proc nibutanLb(lb, ub: int; f: Pred1[int]): int =
  var lb = lb
  var ub = ub
  while ub - lb > 1:
    let mid = (ub + lb) div 2
    if f(mid):
      lb = mid
    else:
      ub = mid
  return lb

# (lb, ub]
proc nibutanUb(lb, ub: int; f: Pred1[int]): int =
  var lb = lb
  var ub = ub
  while ub - lb > 1:
    let mid = (ub + lb) div 2
    if f(mid):
      ub = mid
    else:
      lb = mid
  return ub

# 参考: https://atcoder.jp/contests/exawizards2019/submissions/4780769
def c_snuke_the_wizard(N, Q, S, Magic):
    # ゴーレムが隣のゴーレムを追い抜くことはありえない
    # (複数体重なれば、その後同じように動いていくため)。
    # よって、 左端で消滅する、最初に最も右にいるゴーレムleftと、
    # 右端で消滅する、最初に最も左にいるゴーレムrightが分かればいい。
    # (left >= right とはなりえない)
    # これを二分探索で求めれば O(Qlog(N)) で解を得られる。
    def is_vanished(x, direction):
        """
        x番のゴーレムがdirection(leftまたはrightのいずれか)で指定される端で
        消滅するかどうか判定する
        """
        for t, d in Magic:
            if t == S[x]:
                # 呪文で指定されたマスに注目したゴーレムがいた。
                # 呪文の内容に従ってゴーレムを移動させる
                x = x - 1 if d == 'L' else x + 1
            # 左端/右端 で消滅することとなった
            if x == -1:
                return True if direction == 'left' else False
            if x == N:
                return False if direction == 'left' else True
        return False

    def binary_search(accept, reject, direction):
        """
        direction が 'left' の場合は accept番とその左側のゴーレムが消滅する。
        direction が 'right' の場合は accept番とその右側のゴーレムが消滅する。
        direction によって accept と reject の位置関係が逆転することに注意。
        """
        while abs(accept - reject) > 1:
            mid = (accept + reject) // 2
            if is_vanished(mid, direction):
                accept = mid
            else:
                reject = mid
        return accept + 1 if direction == 'left' else N - accept
    return N - binary_search(-1, N, 'left') - binary_search(N, -1, 'right')

def c_snuke_the_wizard(N, Q, S, Magic):
    # ゴーレムが隣のゴーレムを追い抜くことはありえない
    # (複数体重なれば、その後同じように動いていくため)。
    # よって、 左端で消滅する、最初に最も右にいるゴーレムleftと、
    # 右端で消滅する、最初に最も左にいるゴーレムrightが分かればいい。
    # (left >= right とはなりえない)
    # これを二分探索で求めれば O(Qlog(N)) で解を得られる。
    def is_vanished(x, direction):
        """
        x番のゴーレムがdirection(leftまたはrightのいずれか)で指定される端で
        消滅するかどうか判定する
        """
        for t, d in Magic:
            if t == S[x]:
                # 呪文で指定されたマスに注目したゴーレムがいた。
                # 呪文の内容に従ってゴーレムを移動させる
                if d == 'L':
                    x -= 1
                else:
                    x += 1
            if x in (-1, N):
                return True  # 左端/右端 で消滅することとなった
            # if x == -1:
            #     return True if direction == 'left' else False
            # if x == N:
            #     return False if direction == 'left' else True
        return False

    def binary_search(accept, reject, direction):
        """
        direction が 'left' の場合は accept番とその左側のゴーレムが消滅する。
        direction が 'right' の場合は accept番とその右側のゴーレムが消滅する。
        direction によって accept と reject の位置関係が逆転することに注意。
        """
        while abs(accept - reject) > 1:
            mid = (accept + reject) // 2
            if is_vanished(mid, direction):
                accept = mid
            else:
                reject = mid
        return accept + 1 if direction == 'left' else N - accept
    return max(N - binary_search(-1, N, 'left') - binary_search(N, -1, 'right'), 0)

#そのゴーレムがどちらかの端にたどり着けるかの関数
#True, Falseを返す
def canReachEnd(iL, dir):
  #iLは初期マス(1~N), dirは方向(L:-1, R:1)
  
  #nowL:今いるマスの位置
  nowL = iL
  #nowt:今いるマスに書いてある文字
  nowt = s[iL]
  for t, d in zip(T, D):
    if t == nowt:
      #左に動いても右に動いてもdを足せばok
      #端に落ちたら文字が'#'なので気にしない
      nowL += d
      nowt = s[nowL]
      
  if dir == 1 and nowL == N+1:
    return True
  elif dir == -1 and nowL == 0:
    return True
  else: return False

def recursive(location, count_operation):
    if memo[location][count_operation] != -1:
        return memo[location][count_operation]
    if count_operation >= Q:
        return True
    #if Q - count_operation < min(location, N - location):

                    memo[location][count_operation] = 0
                    exist = False

                else:
                    exist = recursive(location + 1, id + 1)
                    break
            else:
                if location == 0:
                    memo[location][count_operation] = 0
                    exist = False
                    break
                else:
                    exist = recursive(location - 1, id + 1)

# 参考: https://atcoder.jp/contests/exawizards2019/submissions/4780769
def c_snuke_the_wizard(N, Q, S, Magic):
    # ゴーレムが隣のゴーレムを追い抜くことはありえない
    # (複数体重なれば、その後同じように動いていくため)。
    # よって、 左端で消滅する、最初に最も右にいるゴーレムleftと、
    # 右端で消滅する、最初に最も左にいるゴーレムrightが分かればいい。
    # (left >= right とはなりえない)
    # これを二分探索で求めれば O(Qlog(N)) で解を得られる。
    def is_vanished(x, direction):
        """
        x番のゴーレムがdirection(leftまたはrightのいずれか)で指定される端で
        消滅するかどうか判定する
        """
        for t, d in Magic:
            if t == S[x]:
                # 呪文で指定されたマスに注目したゴーレムがいた。
                # 呪文の内容に従ってゴーレムを移動させる
                x = x - 1 if d == 'L' else x + 1
            if x in (-1, N):
                return True  # 左端/右端 で消滅することとなった
        return False

    def binary_search(accept, reject, direction):
        """
        direction が 'left' の場合は accept番とその左側のゴーレムが消滅する。
        direction が 'right' の場合は accept番とその右側のゴーレムが消滅する。
        direction によって accept と reject の位置関係が逆転することに注意。
        """
        while abs(accept - reject) > 1:
            mid = (accept + reject) // 2
            if is_vanished(mid, direction):
                accept = mid
            else:
                reject = mid
        return accept + 1 if direction == 'left' else N - accept
    return max(N - binary_search(-1, N, 'left') - binary_search(N, -1, 'right'), 0)

def bleft(fn, x, lo, hi):
    """
    (memo) いっぱい呼ぶなら np.searchsorted のほうがベクトル化されててはやそう
    lo から hi-1 のうち、fn の結果が x 以上となる、最も左の値
    bisect.bisect_left と同じ
    https://docs.python.org/ja/3/library/bisect.html
    :param callable fn:
    :param x:
    :param int lo: 最小値
    :param int hi: 最大値 + 1
    :return: lo <= ret <= hi
    """
    while lo < hi:
        mid = (lo + hi) // 2
        if fn(mid) < x:
            lo = mid + 1
        else:
            hi = mid
    return lo

# 参考: https://atcoder.jp/contests/exawizards2019/submissions/4780769
def c_snuke_the_wizard(N, Q, S, Magic):
    # ゴーレムが隣のゴーレムを追い抜くことはありえない
    # (複数体重なれば、その後同じように動いていくため)。
    # よって、 左端で消滅する、最初に最も右にいるゴーレムleftと、
    # 右端で消滅する、最初に最も左にいるゴーレムrightが分かればいい。
    # (left >= right とはなりえない)
    # これを二分探索で求めれば O(Qlog(N)) で解を得られる。
    def is_vanished(x, direction):
        """
        x番のゴーレムがdirection(leftまたはrightのいずれか)で指定される端で
        消滅するかどうか判定する
        """
        for t, d in Magic:
            if t == S[x]:
                # 呪文で指定されたマスに注目したゴーレムがいた。
                # 呪文の内容に従ってゴーレムを移動させる
                x = x - 1 if d == 'L' else x + 1
            if x in (-1, N):
                return True  # 左端/右端 で消滅することとなった
        return False

    def binary_search(accept, reject, direction):
        """
        direction が 'left' の場合は accept番とその左側のゴーレムが消滅する。
        direction が 'right' の場合は accept番とその右側のゴーレムが消滅する。
        direction によって accept と reject の位置関係が逆転することに注意。
        """
        while abs(accept - reject) > 1:
            mid = (accept + reject) // 2
            if is_vanished(mid, direction):
                accept = mid
            else:
                reject = mid
        return accept + 1 if direction == 'left' else N - accept
    return N - binary_search(-1, N, 'left') - binary_search(N, -1, 'right')

#左に落ちるやつで一番右のゴーレムのインデックスを探す
def leftbinarysearch():
    l = 0
    r = N + 1
    cnt = 0#デバグ用カウンタ
    while(l<r):
        m = (l+r)//2 + 1#探索範囲の中央値のIndexのゴーレムでシミュレーション
        cur = m#探す一つのゴーレムの現在地
        fall = False
        # print(l,r,m)
        for i in range(Q):
            if t[i] == S[cur]:
                if d[i] == "L":
                    cur-=1
                else:
                    cur+=1
                if(cur == 0):#左端に落ちるなら次はもっと右のやつを確かめる
                    l = m
                    fall = True
                    break
                elif(cur == N+1):#右端に落ちるなら下の処理に飛ぶ
                    break
        if not fall:#落ちなかったならそれより左端を探す
            r = m - 1
        cnt+=1
        # if(cnt == 10):print("loop", file=sys.stderr);break;
    return l

def move_golem(text, dir, grids):
    for i in range(n):
        if grids[i].word == text and grids[i].has_golem != 0:
            move_golem = grids[i].has_golem
            grids[i].has_golem = 0
            if(dir == 'L' and i != 0):
                grids[i-1].will_move_golem += move_golem
            if(dir == 'R' and i != n-1):
                grids[i+1].will_move_golem += move_golem
        else:
            continue
    for g in grids:
        g.has_golem += g.will_move_golem
        g.will_move_golem = 0

def answer(grids):
    sum_golem = 0
    for g in grids:
        sum_golem += g.has_golem

    return sum_golem

def bis(p, ok=-1, ng=10**18):
    mid = (ok + ng) // 2
    return (
        ok if abs(ok - ng) == 1 else
        bis(p, mid, ng) if p(mid) else
        bis(p, ok, mid)
    )

# N + 1の場合、マスNから右に移動しようとして消滅したことを表す。

        lambda j, q: (
            0 if j == 0 else
            j - 1 if 1 <= j <= N and s[j - 1] == q[0] and q[1] == 'L' else
            j if 1 <= j <= N and s[j - 1] != q[0] else
            j + 1 if 1 <= j <= N and s[j - 1] == q[0] and q[1] == 'R' else
            N + 1
        ),
        zip(t, d),

    )

def bis(p, ok=-1, ng=10**18):
    mid = (ok + ng) // 2
    return (
        ok if abs(ok - ng) == 1 else
        bis(p, mid, ng) if p(mid) else
        bis(p, ok, mid)
    )

def c_snuke_the_wizard(N, Q, S, Magic):
    # ゴーレムが隣のゴーレムを追い抜くことはありえない
    # (複数体重なれば、その後同じように動いていくため)。
    # よって、 左端で消滅する、最初に最も右にいるゴーレムleftと、
    # 右端で消滅する、最初に最も左にいるゴーレムrightが分かればいい。
    # (left >= right とはなりえない)
    # これを二分探索で求めれば O(Qlog(N)) で解を得られる。
    def is_vanished(x, direction):
        """
        x番のゴーレムがdirection(leftまたはrightのいずれか)で指定される端で
        消滅するかどうか判定する
        """
        for t, d in Magic:
            if t == S[x]:
                # 呪文で指定されたマスに注目したゴーレムがいた。
                # 呪文の内容に従ってゴーレムを移動させる
                if d == 'L':
                    x -= 1
                else:
                    x += 1
            if x in (-1, N):
                return True  # 左端/右端 で消滅することとなった
        return False

    def binary_search(accept, reject, direction):
        """
        direction が 'left' の場合は accept番とその左側のゴーレムが消滅する。
        direction が 'right' の場合は accept番とその右側のゴーレムが消滅する。
        direction によって accept と reject の位置関係が逆転することに注意。
        """
        while abs(accept - reject) > 1:
            mid = (accept + reject) // 2
            if is_vanished(mid, direction):
                accept = mid
            else:
                reject = mid
        return accept + 1 if direction == 'left' else N - accept
    return max(N - binary_search(-1, N, 'left') - binary_search(N, -1, 'right'), 0)

def simulate(positionString,actionList,firstposition):
	# ある位置のゴーレムに対してactionListを行ったところどこへ行くかを調査する
	# 定数として呪文で示される位置＋方向情報を設定する
	COMMANDPLACE = 0
	COMMANDWAY = 1
	position = firstposition
	actionCount = len(actionList)
	for i in range(0,actionCount,+1):
		wizardCommand = actionList[i]
		# print("wizardCommand is {}".format(wizardCommand))
		# もし位置情報の文字と一致していたら方向へプラス
		# print("Now i is {}".format(actionList[i]))
#		logger.debug("{}番目の呪文を唱えます".format(i))
		wizardPointPlaceStr = wizardCommand[COMMANDPLACE]
		nowPositionStr = positionString[position]
		if wizardPointPlaceStr != nowPositionStr:
#			logger.debug("呪文指定位置{} != 現在の位置({}番目)情報{}なので動きません".format(wizardPointPlaceStr,position,nowPositionStr))
			# このコマンドでは動かないためスルーする
			continue
		else:
			if wizardCommand[COMMANDWAY] == 'L':
#				logger.debug(
#					"呪文指定位置{} != 現在の位置({}番目)情報{}なので←に動きます".format(wizardPointPlaceStr, position, nowPositionStr))
				position = position -1
			else:
#				logger.debug(
#					"呪文指定位置{} != 現在の位置({}番目)情報{}なので→に動きます".format(wizardPointPlaceStr, position, nowPositionStr))
				position = position + 1
		if position < 0 :
			return -1
		if len(positionString) -1 < position:
			return 1
	return 0

def solveProblem(N,Q,positionString,actionList):
#	pos = (-1 + N)/2
	counter = 0
	for position in range(0,N,+1):
		simresult = simulate(positionString,actionList,position)
		if simresult == 1:
#			print("{} に 合ったゴーレムは右に落ちました".format(position))
			counter = counter + 1
		elif simresult == -1 :
#			print("{} に あったゴーレムは左に落ちました".format(position))
			counter = counter + 1
	answer = N-counter
	return answer

    # (複数体重なれば、その後同じように動いていくため)。
    # よって、 左端で消滅する、最初に最も右にいるゴーレムleftと、
    # 右端で消滅する、最初に最も左にいるゴーレムrightが分かればいい。
    # (left >= right とはなりえない)
    # これを二分探索で求めれば O(Qlog(N)) で解を得られる。
    def is_vanished(x, direction):
        """
        x番のゴーレムがdirection(leftまたはrightのいずれか)で指定される端で
        消滅するかどうか判定する
        """
        for t, d in Magic:
            if t == S[x]:
                # 呪文で指定されたマスに注目したゴーレムがいた。
                # 呪文の内容に従ってゴーレムを移動させる
                if d == 'L':
                    x -= 1
                else:
                    x += 1
            if x in (-1, N):
                return True  # 左端/右端 で消滅することとなった
            # if x == -1:
            #     return True if direction == 'left' else False
            # if x == N:

        return False

    def binary_search(accept, reject, direction):
        """
        direction が 'left' の場合は accept番とその左側のゴーレムが消滅する。
        direction が 'right' の場合は accept番とその右側のゴーレムが消滅する。
        direction によって accept と reject の位置関係が逆転することに注意。
        """
        while abs(accept - reject) > 1:
            mid = (accept + reject) // 2
            if is_vanished(mid, direction):
                accept = mid
            else:
                reject = mid
        return accept + 1 if direction == 'left' else N - accept
    return max(N - binary_search(-1, N, 'left') - binary_search(N, -1, 'right'), 0)

def simulation_R(command,s,now,N):
    for pair in command:
        if pair[0] == s[now]:
            if pair[1] == 'L':
                now -= 1
            elif pair[1] == 'R':
                now += 1
        if now < 0:
            return False
        elif now >= N:
            return True
    return False

def simulation_L(command,s,now,N):
    for pair in command:
        if pair[0] == s[now]:
            if pair[1] == 'L':
                now -= 1
            elif pair[1] == 'R':
                now += 1
        if now < 0:
            return True
        elif now >= N:
            return False
    return False


def binary_serch_R(command,s,N):
    left = 0
    right = N-1
    if simulation_R(command,s,left,N) :
        return -1
    if simulation_R(command,s,right,N) == False:
        return N


    while not simulation_R(command,s,left,N) and simulation_R(command,s,right,N):
        mid = int((left+right)/2)
        # print(mid)
        if right - left == 1:
            return right
        if simulation_R(command,s,mid,N) :
            right = mid
        else :
            left = mid 
    return right

def binary_serch_L(command,s,N):
    left = 0
    right = N-1
    if simulation_L(command,s,left,N) == False :
        return -1
    if simulation_L(command,s,right,N):
        return N
        
    while simulation_L(command,s,left,N) and (not simulation_L(command,s,right,N)):
        mid = int((left+right)/2)
        if right - left == 1:
            return left
        if not simulation_L(command,s,mid,N) :
            right = mid
        else :
            left = mid 
    return left

    curr = i
    for tt, dd in zip(t, d):
        if tt == s[curr]:
            if dd == "R":
                curr += 1
                # print("cuz", tt, dd, curr)
            else:
                curr -= 1
                # print("cuz", tt, dd, curr)
        if curr >= N:
            return "right"
        elif curr < 0:
            return "left"
    return "stay"

    while lo < hi:
        mid = lo + (hi - lo) // 2
        if x < move(mid):
            hi = mid

    return lo

    while lo < hi:
        mid = lo + (hi - lo) // 2
        if move(mid) < x:
            lo = mid +1
        else: # e <= t
            hi = mid
    return lo

nl = lambda: list(nm())
ns = lambda: sys.stdin.readline().rstrip()

N, Q = nm()
board = ns()
assert len(board) == N
spells = []
for i in range(Q):
    t, d = ns().split()
    spells.append((t, d))


def solve():
    head, tail = -1, N
    for i in range(Q - 1, -1, -1):
        if head + 1 == tail:
            break
        t, d = spells[i]
        if t == board[head + 1] and d == "L":
            head += 1
        if t == board[tail - 1] and d == "R":
            tail -= 1
    return tail - head - 1


print(solve())

def getInt(): return int(input())
def getIntList(): return [int(x) for x in input().split()]
def zeros(n): return [0]*n

def prob():
    N, Q = getIntList()
    S = input()
    pos = [[] for i in range(26)]  # 英字別の位置
    cell = [1 for i in range(N+2)]
    cell[0] = cell[N+1] = 0
    for i in range(N):
        pos[ord(S[i])-ord('A')].append(i+1)
    for i in range(Q):
        frame, direction = [x for x in input().split()]
        idx = ord(frame) - ord('A')
        posList = pos[idx]
        if direction == 'R':
            for k in range(len(posList)-1, -1, -1):
                p = posList[k]
                cell[p+1] += cell[p]
                cell[p] = 0
        else:  # 'L'
            for k in range(len(posList)):
                p = posList[k]
                cell[p-1] += cell[p]
                cell[p] = 0
    return N - cell[0] - cell[N+1]

ans = prob()
print(ans)

import sys

N, Q = map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())

s = sys.stdin.readline()
golem_place = list(range(N))
golem_num = N

Q_list = []
for i in range(Q):
    t, d = sys.stdin.readline().split()
    Q_list.append([t, d])

# 呪文の数だけループする
for i in range(Q):
    t = Q_list[i][0]
    if Q_list[i][1] == "L":
        adder = -1
    else:
        adder = 1
    # golemの移動
    # 削除フラグ建て
    delete_count = 0
    for j in reversed(range(golem_num)):
        if s[golem_place[j]] == t:
            golem_place[j] = golem_place[j] + adder
            if golem_place[j] < 0 or golem_place[j] >= N:
                delete_count += 1
                golem_place.pop(j)

    # ゴーレムを排除
    golem_num = golem_num - delete_count

print(golem_num)
